recommendation: Keep the human-review audit. FHIR-I should decide in the Extension Pack whether uncertainPeriod remains the intended date/dateTime solution and whether a separate time-only or Timing-specific extension is needed; core should only receive follow-up narrative or registry updates if the work group explicitly requests them.
issue_request: FHIR-38726 is a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core change request asking for support for imprecise dates on resources such as Condition, AdverseEvent, MedicationStatement, and Procedure. The resolution said to define uncertain extensions for date, dateTime, and time with upper/lower bounds when the exact value is unknown.
initial_application: Core commit 5436c013544f8333aabd7d6f919afb9987922887 added an uncertainPeriod row to source/profiles/element-extensions-spreadsheet.xml with date and dateTime contexts and valuePeriod. It did not add a primitive time context or separate uncertainDate, uncertainDateTime, or uncertainTime definitions. Commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 later removed standard extension definitions from the R5 core source.
additional_context: Current core source still actively includes the element-extensions spreadsheet via source/fhir.ini, but that spreadsheet no longer contains uncertainPeriod or uncertainTime rows; core only retains OID registry entries for timing-uncertainDate and uncertainPeriod. The FHIR Extension Pack now contains uncertainPeriod for date and dateTime with valuePeriod, while FHIR-41649 later deprecated timing-uncertainDate in favor of uncertainPeriod. Zulip and FHIR-I minutes after the initial implementation record concerns that FHIR-38726/FHIR-39336 had not covered the intended scope and should be pulled out of R5 for later discussion. FHIR-39336 is already represented on the combined branch with a human-review audit commit for the time-bound part of the same change family.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Reintroducing extension definitions in core would edit an artifact family now maintained in the Extension Pack, and adding missing time semantics would require a work-group decision that the later community evidence shows was unresolved.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-39336 was resolved as part of FHIR-38726 and is already audited on the combined branch as human-review for unresolved time-only bounds.
FHIR-extensions later deprecated timing-uncertainDate in favor of uncertainPeriod, confirming the external date/dateTime direction without resolving primitive time support.
